title: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who hates waiting and, against the group's advice, decides to go back to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker with a fire within her whom Chandra tutors, and who volunteers to help her reach Teferi and the World Tree.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: Wrenn's tree companion, who cannot lend her the power she needs.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who hosts the safe house and leaves rather than join Chandra.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who coordinates the plan to warn the planes and opposes Chandra's idea.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who returned from New Phyrexia and tries to stop Chandra from going back.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who returned from New Phyrexia wounded.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker who returned from New Phyrexia and describes the corrupted World Tree.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who did not return; Kaito says he became one of them.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker whom Chandra loves, reported captured by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A lithomancer planeswalker taken by the Phyrexians and heading to Zendikar.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who ran Jace through and carried the sylex into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker lost to Phyrexia, who killed Jaya.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker lost to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Chandra's mentor, who taught her to control her fire through breathing and who was killed by Ajani.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time-manipulating planeswalker who is missing but whom Wrenn believes can be reached.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader whose fleshless legions lead the invasion.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker who is thought to have escaped home.

entities.name: Safe house
entities.description: A warded cabin on Dominaria where the planeswalkers wait for news.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: Liliana's manor to be reconstructed.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the safe house marsh is.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane from which the invasion is launched.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane of vibrant skies.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane where the Roil once showed Chandra nature's turbulent growth.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane from which the World Tree essence was stolen.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school Liliana will send word to.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Phyrexian World Tree made from stolen Kaldheim essence, used to invade planes; Wrenn insists it is alive.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: A bomb Elspeth took into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes.

entities.name: The Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on the Multiverse that has begun.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde invading the Multiverse.

events.summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.
events.quote: For two weeks they'll wait here in one of Liliana's cabins on Dominaria.

events.summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
events.quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

events.summary: Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar report that Phyrexia has corrupted the World Tree and is using it to invade the planes.
events.quote: They're using it to invade the other planes.

events.summary: Kaya tells Chandra that the Phyrexians got Nissa.
The survivors reveal Jace did not return, having become one of them, and Nahiri was taken.
Kaya explains that Elspeth ran Jace through and took the sylex into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Elspeth ran him through, picked up the sylex and planeswalked into the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: Liliana leaves to send word to Strixhaven, rejecting the story of noble sacrifice.
events.quote: I'm going to send word to Strixhaven.

events.summary: Chandra proposes returning to New Phyrexia to take down the World Tree, and Kaya, Vivien, Tyvar and Kaito refuse.
events.quote: There must be some other way to take the World Tree down.

events.summary: Kaya forbids Chandra from going, warning she would be compleated.
events.quote: I can't let you go back.

events.summary: Chandra erupts in anger when told to abandon people stuck on New Phyrexia and leaves.
events.quote: I'm not leaving our friends behind.

events.summary: Chandra confronts Liliana, who says she knows funeral bells and leaves in a blink of inky vapor.
events.quote: I just know funeral bells when I hear them.

events.summary: Chandra walks into the marsh and weeps, afraid to planeswalk alone to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Going to New Phyrexia is the right thing to do.

events.summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
events.quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

events.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven leave to head for New Phyrexia while unseen watchers observe them.
Unseen watchers declare they are there to witness the beginning of the end.
events.quote: We are here to witness the beginning of the end.

relations.note: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her fire
relations.quote: feeling like it's the thing a mentor should do

relations.note: taught her breathing to control fire
relations.quote: Jaya used to tell her that to calm her down when things got bad

relations.note: close friend whom Chandra refuses to give up on
relations.quote: It's as easy to imagine Nissa here as it is to call fire.

relations.note: Seven is her companion who has done so much for her
relations.quote: Seven has done so much for me

the two have a mutual understanding
relations.quote: the two of them had always understood not to ask that of each other
